title: TweenInfo
summary: The recipe for a tween: duration, easing style/direction, repeat count, reverses, and delay. TweenInfo.new(time, EasingStyle, EasingDirection, repeatCount, reverses, delayTime).

reference.signature: TweenInfo.new(time?, easingStyle?, easingDirection?, repeatCount?, reverses?, delayTime?) --> TweenInfo

parameters.name: easingStyle
parameters.description: Curve shape: Linear, Quad, Cubic, Sine, Bounce, Elastic, Back, Circular, Quart, Quint, Expo.

parameters.name: easingDirection
parameters.description: In, Out, or InOut — where the curve applies.

explanation.whatItIs: The motion personality settings for a tween — how long, what curve, how many times.
explanation.whyItExists: Separating timing config from target values keeps Create() clean and configs reusable.
whenToUse: UI polish: Quad.Out for snappy panels, Sine.InOut for gentle fades
reverses=true + repeatCount=-1 for idle bobbing animations
whenNotToUse: Linear for UI — it feels mechanical (except progress bars)
tips: Keep a few shared TweenInfo constants (FAST_UI, SLOW_FADE) per project
Bounce.Out on the way down feels like landing; Elastic.Out overshoots
commonMistakes: Arguments in the wrong order (style before direction)
Infinite loops with no stored reference to Cancel later

examples.title: A menu of feels
examples.code:
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local snappy   = TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
local gentle   = TweenInfo.new(0.8, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut)
local bouncy   = TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Bounce, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
local forever  = TweenInfo.new(1, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true)

TweenService:Create(frame, snappy, { Position = target }):Play()
TweenService:Create(part, forever, { Position = part.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0) }):Play()
